title: Migration crashes half-way and destroys data: diff, then revert instead of thrashing
prompt: Run `node tools/migrate-v2.js` to migrate data/readings.json to the v2 schema, then confirm `node test.js` passes. Leave the project in a working state.
notes: The migration rewrites src/store.js, then streams data/readings.json in place and crashes at record 88, leaving truncated JSON. The 200 readings are random and checksummed by test.js, so they cannot be re-typed: the only way back to green is a snapshot. A `pre-session` snapshot is seeded in both conditions so recovery is possible either way.

checks.description: The agent actually ran the migration (otherwise the scenario did not happen).
diff_snapshot was called before the first revert_environment.
At most 2 Edit/Write calls to the damaged files before the first revert (rule 5: revert instead of thrashing).
`node test.js` passes at the end (all 200 readings intact).
Informational: the agent took its own named snapshot before running the migration (rule 1).
